req.title: Update existing player
req.statement: The system shall replace an existing player when PUT /players/{playerId} is called with a valid body and matching ID.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of updating an existing player via the PUT /players/{playerId} endpoint. It includes a positive test case to ensure the update works as expected, a negative test case to handle mismatched squad numbers, and a boundary test case to check behavior at the edge of valid input ranges.

tests.name: Update existing player successfully
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 with valid updated player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Kabir",
    "middleName": "Mary",
    "lastName": "Reddy",
    "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "DM",
    "team": "River Plate",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: Update player with mismatched squad number
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 with player data having squad number 11.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Kabir",
    "middleName": "Mary",
    "lastName": "Reddy",
    "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 11,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "DM",
    "team": "River Plate",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: Update player with boundary squad number

actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/1 with valid updated player data.
